verdict.rationale: The evidence pack documents no user-configurable background automation or workflow capability for Datadog, such as scheduled or triggered workflows or autonomous agents acting on the user's behalf. The closest items are adjacent features: managed LLM evaluators that 'go live' after publishing, monitoring of Bits AI agents in Agent Console, and the API and client libraries as developer building blocks. None of these is a documented autonomous automation feature for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
